Trainer, you're a lifesaver!
To think you came to help out again this year.

We were wrapped in the gentle ocean breeze together.
The golden sea, illuminated by the sunset, ebbed and flowed continuously.

Yes—I really like spending time waiting like this.
It's such a gentle... and warm time.

............Yes.
—Trainer.

...—Fufu.
Indeed.

If... if the two of us continue waiting for the same flower together—
then when it finally blooms, I can share that joy with you all the same.

Did you... help out all on your own in the past, Trainer?
With this amount, it seems like it would take quite a while.

Ohh...! As expected of Trainer's trainee Umamusume.
I'll be in your care today.

You're helping out—entirely of your own accord, right?
Um... why go to such lengths?
Oh my...

Yes, it was all thanks to Bouquet-san's help as well.
Thank you both so very much.

It might be the very same feeling—when raising flowers.
We might not know when the blossoms will open, but—

That's what's so helpful! And to think your trainee Umamusume would
come all the way out here to help, too... Thank you both so much for taking the trouble.

And if such a future awaits us—
then showing her the moment those flowers bloom is my duty, and mine alone.
Surely—not just with flowers, but with the future far ahead, too.

Trainer, Bouquet-san, thank you for your hard work.
Thanks to you, preparations are completely finished!
...I felt like... I would be able to share that joy with you, Trainer.

I'm sorry, I somehow... just remembered.
About when the two of us went to the botanical garden—and waited.
In that case... this little one—must have bloomed just now.

Please let me treat you to dinner as a thank you.
I'll call for you once it's ready.

A single petal nestled in the sand. The madder-red sky and the golden sea.
And—Curren Bouquetd'or's gentle smile.

Training camp sessions are bound to be rigorous.
That is all the more reason why I want the Umamusume to stay comfortable.
Something in the sand reflected the setting sun, sparkling brightly.

Caring for it, tending to it while we wait...
Visualizing the moment it blooms is wonderful. And besides—

Certainly, helping out like this goes beyond my job duties.
Still... I want to do whatever I can.
......Yes. Let us wait together.

And so, while waiting for dinner to be ready,
I decided to take a stroll along the nearby beach with her.

If the wind hadn't blown—
would it have stayed buried in the sand forever, I wonder?

Right now, we don't even know what shape it will take.
It might take a lot of time, but—
The flower I see with you... is sure to be beautiful.

No, no, you two will be busy starting tomorrow.
Please just take it easy today. See you later!

However... there is no one here right now. Only her gentle voice echoes softly...
While outside the window, the trees sway gently in the breeze.
Thinking about it that way... gives me such a warm feeling.

...Somehow, lately—wherever we go,
I feel like I'm always waiting for something with you, Trainer.

Trainer, I've brought in
all the hand towels that were drying.

The day before summer camp. We arrived at the lodge ahead of the other Umamusume
to help out with the preparations.

I heard many of my classmates will be participating in the camp as well.
It looks like it will be—very lively starting tomorrow.

This is—a seashell, isn't it?
It looks just like a cherry blossom petal—so lovely.

—Fufu, somehow... I want to see it even more now.
A future... that will bloom far down the road.
Until the flowers bloom—together with you.

Ah—yes. It's not something we usually get to do—
and I wanted to be of help to everyone else participating.

—Yes.
The feel of the tatami, the soft sunlight—it's all so soothing.

In that case...—would you like to take a walk outside?
The sun is setting soon, and it should be cooling down...

I looked at the mountain of pillows stacked neatly in the closet,
once again reminded of how many Umamusume would be attending the camp.

...Well then—the pillows are all ready,
what shall we help with next—

Picking up the shell glittering in the sand—
I held it out directly to her.

Getting closer, I saw a tiny pink object
peeking out from the sand, catching the light of the evening sun.
Trainer...?
That gentle, reassuring... peaceful time.

Just then, a sudden sea breeze gusted by...
and up ahead, I noticed sand swirling into the air. And then—

...Alright, that's the last cover on...
Trainer, this is the final pillow.

What a beautiful sunset.
It reflects off the waves—sparkling so brilliantly.
